title: Vuvuzela
summary: The vuvuzela is a long plastic horn that produces a loud monotone, widely associated with South African football crowds. The player buzzes the lips into a mouthpiece, and the volume and pitch change with air pressure and technique.
howToPlay: Four notes of the horn are lit along it, the higher ones nearer the mouthpiece.
A band of breath runs from the mouth to the note you strike, and rings of sound leave the wide bell.
Long notes swell quickly: strike close to the beat and let them ring.
rules: A call is a line of long notes, each struck close to its beat.
Long notes swell slowly: strike on the beat and let them ring.
The round ends when the last note has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: In a crowd thousands of them sound together as one steady drone.
